model: E=64, topk=8, C=24, independent uniform token routes; exact expert-group loading means one copy per initial miss
target: first action full-step unique weight bytes, not whole episode or wall
online_inputs: known candidate token count, expert capacity and weights; no post-action routes used
assumptions: entry resident identity independent of future uniform routes; no temporal or cross-token correlation; this is intentionally a simple analytical baseline
scope: new action and workload shape on same calibration documents, not document holdout
interpretation: errors test whether saturation-only length/cap model is sufficient; do not reinterpret a failed uniform assumption as failure of the research problem
